methodologyNotes: Covers full-length and 3/4-length sleeping pads for backpacking and camping (air-construction, self-inflating, and closed-cell foam) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes plug-in inflatable air mattresses, cots, and accessories (standalone pumps, pillows). Price is MSRP in USD for the regular/standard length. rValue is the ASTM F3340 insulation R-value (dimensionless; higher is warmer), null if not disclosed. padType is one of air, self-inflating, or closed-cell-foam. weightGrams is the manufacturer's stated packaged weight of the regular length in grams. thicknessCm is inflated loft (height) in centimeters. dimensionsCm is inflated length x width of the regular size in centimeters. packedSizeCm is packed length x diameter in centimeters (folded L x W x H for foam pads). insulationType is one of down-fill, synthetic-fill, reflective-film, foam, or none. inflationType is one of manual, pump-sack, self-inflating, or none. shellDenier is the top face-fabric denier (D); lower is lighter and less durable; null if not disclosed. shape is one of rectangular, tapered, or mummy.
